_comment: Indian state/UT name (lowercase, matching what OpenStreetMap Nominatim's reverse-geocode returns) -> AgriSphere language code. Only states with a clear majority regional language among SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES (see i18n/index.js) are mapped; states without one map to 'hi' (the Hindi belt) rather than being guessed at. Consumed by i18n/locationLanguage.js.
